scan.title: Scan
scan.heroTitle: What kind of waste is this?
scan.heroBody: Take a photo of one item. EcoStep's AI identifies it and explains how to dispose of it safely in Rwanda.
scan.bioExamples: Food scraps, peels, leaves, paper, wood
scan.bioExplainer: This breaks down naturally. It can be composted into fertilizer instead of going to landfill.
scan.nonBioExplainer: This does not break down naturally. Keep it separate so it can be reused or recycled — never burn it.
scan.uncertainExplainer: The AI couldn't identify a clear waste item. Try a closer photo of a single item in good light.
scan.analysingBody: EcoStep's AI is looking at your photo
scan.disclaimer: AI estimate — follow your district's waste guidance.
scan.noneBody: Scan your first item to see it here.
scan.tip1: Tip: banana peels compost in just a few weeks.
scan.tip2: Tip: a plastic bottle can last more than 450 years.
scan.tip3: Tip: Rwanda banned plastic bags in 2008.
scan.tip4: Tip: never burn plastic — the smoke is toxic.
